description: This Java class defines a utility for creating email templates with different messages for account-related events. It provides static methods to generate email content for account creation, deletion, and password change, using constants and a map structure.

classes.name: EmailTemplate
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to generate email template models for different account-related events.

methods.name: getAccountCreatedEmailTemplate
methods.description: Returns a map with email template data for account creation, including the recipient username and a predefined message.

methods.name: getAccountDeletedEmailTemplate
methods.description: Returns a map with email template data for account deletion, including the recipient username and a predefined message.

methods.name: getChangePasswordEmailTemplate
methods.description: Returns a map with email template data for password change, including the recipient username and a predefined message.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Internal method that creates a basic email template map with recipient and sender names.
